history.description: Single isolated tiny equipment sprite for a polished low top-down pixel-art roguelike. Native pixel art with readable 1-pixel dark plum outline, clean intentional pixel clusters, limited material palettes, three-tone hue-shifted shading, top-left light. Transparent background. No ground, shadow, text, hands, character or glow cloud. Horizontal and perfectly level, firing RIGHT. Rear walnut shoulder stock at left x=2, hand grip at x=8,y=9, barrel extends right to x=25,y=6. Entire opaque weapon is 24 to 25 pixels wide and at most 9 pixels high, vertically centered. Two transparent pixels of margin. An elegant single-shot antique hunting rifle. A long dark walnut shoulder stock on the left, slender long aged-brass barrel and tiny iron muzzle on the right. Restrained sunset-copper inlay and one ivory sight. Recognizable long precise hunting rifle, not a revolver, not a modern rifle. No scope.
